content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That range is well supported for muscle gain. Spread it over 3 to 5 meals, with roughly 0.3 to 0.4 g/kg each. For example, at 75 kg that's about 120 to 165 g a day. 💪

Hit your total calories too. A small surplus will help your bench goal more than extra protein beyond that range.
